signals.entity: Δήμος Πωγωνίου (Pogoni, Epirus) / Τράπεζα Πειραιώς (Piraeus Bank)
signals.signal: Municipal council decision 76/2026 of 14/07/2026 grants Piraeus Bank FREE use of part of the central square of Delvinaki, plus municipal electricity supply, to REINSTALL an ATM. The decision states the removal of Delvinaki's only Piraeus Bank ATM was 'a heavy blow' to residents, elderly people, businesses and visitors, and that after coordinated municipal lobbying Piraeus Bank committed to reinstall it immediately.
signals.implies: Greek rural cash-access pressure is now producing municipality-funded siting (free space + free power) to get ATMs back into villages — the same political dynamic that produced Hungary's ATM Act and Austria's OeNB rural-ATM framework. Direct read-through to Printec Cash Network S.A. / Cashflex-KEA, which operates the off-site Piraeus ATM estate [STANDING — dated 2025]: each reinstatement is an off-site ATM placement plus cash-in-transit, monitoring and ATM-as-a-Service revenue.
signals.likelihood: Reinstallation committed by the bank; timing not published
signals.followup: Check whether the Delvinaki unit is placed under the Printec/Cashflex off-site estate; sweep Diavgeia for other Greek municipalities offering free space/power for ATMs — a repeatable rural-ATM pipeline.
